accessibility_notes: Focus ring is 3px lime; touch targets are at least 44px.

Reduced-motion removes meaningful animation duration; critical data never uses infinite animation.
Primary action gradient was darkened to keep white text at WCAG AA contrast.

No migration deployment gate, merge or deploy was performed.
